title: Automated TF change detector + graceful apply orchestrator for Private VPC IaC
creator: Michael Chen
description: Goal: Reduce blast radius and manual overhead when applying Terraform changes for Private (VPC) deployments. Implement a pipeline component that: 1) detects the minimal set of terraform modules/resources changed by a PR, 2) runs targeted plan validation + policy-as-code checks (OPA/Conftest) only for impacted modules, 3) posts succinct plan diffs and policy scores to the PR, and 4) performs a staged, graceful apply with preflight and post-apply health checks and automatic rollback if service-level checks regress.
acceptance_criteria: Pull requests produce an automated plan summary comment that lists changed modules and a one-line impact summary for each module.
OPA/Conftest policies run only against impacted modules and publish a score; pipeline fails if score < 80 unless a bypass is explicitly approved by infra-owners.

The pipeline supports two apply modes: canary (apply to a single VPC cluster) and full (apply to all targeted VPCs). Canary mode runs health checks for 10 minutes post-apply and auto-promotes or auto-rolls back based on SLO check results.
Plan artifacts (raw plan JSON) and a compact delta are archived to the infra-artifacts bucket and linked in the PR comment.

If post-apply health checks fail, the pipeline triggers the rollback playbook that restores the most recent successful state snapshot (from state-backups S3) and creates an incident with a prefilled runbook link.
Pipeline integrates tfsec/checkov as optional preflight linters and includes a 'soft-fail' mode for non-blocking policy issues that annotates but does not fail the PR.
End-to-end tests for the pipeline are added to the infra CI with a small simulation harness that emulates plan diffs and mock API responses for health-check endpoints.

2025-02-18 - Samira Kapoor: Design spike complete. Implemented change detection prototype that parses terraform plan JSON and uses module graph to expand ripple changes. Prototype link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/879 (WIP).

2025-02-20 - Security (Anita Rao): Reviewed OPA policies and suggested a strict deny-list for KMS, sg rules opening 0.0.0.0/0, and IAM wildcard admins. Recommended mandatory security_review_required=true for this ticket.

2025-02-24 - Samira Kapoor: Demoed PR comment format to PMs and infra-owners. Trade-off discussion: running full-scan per PR increases confidence but doubles CI costs; we selected targeted-scan default with an opt-in full-scan flag for major infra-wide changes.

2025-02-26 - DevOps (Luca Marin): Implemented S3-backed plan artifact storage and state snapshot exporter. We will retain snapshots for 14 days by default; follow-up required to add longer retention for enterprise customers.
2025-02-28 - QA (Priya Singh): Integration test harness green for prototype flows. Found flaky health-check timing on low-traffic envs; added exponential wait and retries to post-apply checks.

2025-03-01 - Samira Kapoor: Merged first iteration of the orchestrator into feature branch infra/feature/tf-change-detector. Next: add policy scoring threshold config and UI flags in Console rollout page.
